title: Corpus dedup
description: The output of Corpus.Dedup over a corpus-report/2 (or /1) document: the near-duplicate merge across every completed shard of a run. Per shard a keep mask over the product's documents; the clusters of two or more as (shard, ordinal) pairs, listed up to a cap — the masks carry the complete decision. A run without signatures (output stats_and_hashes, or sign false) and a run whose shards' signatures were made with different MinHash parameters are refused, by name.

threshold.description: The Jaccard estimate a pair needed to be one cluster.

bands.description: LSH bands over the signature (16 by default; pipeline.minhash.bands).

hashes.description: Hashes per signature of the signatures merged (128 by default). Absent from documents of controllers before 0.3.0.

shingle_words.description: Words per shingle of the signatures merged (5 by default). Absent from documents of controllers before 0.3.0.

duplicates.description: Documents that are near-duplicates of an earlier one (the mask drops them).

clusters_listed.description: How many of them the document lists.

keep.description: A bitset over the shard's product: bit i of byte i/8, least significant first, 1 = keep document i (the i-th JSON line of the text blob).

clusters.description: Each cluster: its documents as [shard index, ordinal] pairs in ascending order, the representative (the kept one) first.
